source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: Partners may not switch roles at any time during an event, single-dance or multi-dance.

requirement: A future NDCA profile must forbid partners switching roles during an event, within the scope the text states (single-dance or multi-dance).
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A PROFILE-ACTIVATION BLOCKER for the named body. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: gender collection, columns, migrations, role-lock enforcement, UI.
interpretation_notes: CORRECTION of the audit: the audit said 'event' is undefined; the text actually parenthesizes '(single-dance or multi-dance)', which states the scope as covering both event kinds. Remaining interpretation questions: how it applies across rounds of one event; across the dances of a multi-dance event; whether any momentary reversal is tolerated (NDCA states no exception, unlike UCWDC's 'momentary role reversals'); whether it binds a partnership entered in two events; and how it applies to Mixed-Role or same-sex couples under the II.A.7.a definition. The rule applies to couples as defined in II.A.7.a (OD27-NDCA-0002). NDCA effective_from 2026-06-01 is a placeholder convention shared with sibling entries; the rule book states only 'June 2026 EDITION' (OD-30), so the effective date is not verified.
